_help: Paper Mario 64's Sushie on the disc's c_opuku: each PM64 sprite row keyed per part, a key at every change of the sprite's frame (step), over the row's own loop. Our numbers, judged against the ROM's frames (local-docs/poses/sushie.md). Parts: pPlane4 near fin, pPlane13 far fin, pPlane7 tail, pPlane10 dorsal fin, pPlane9 lips (face T_1@2 half open, T_1@4 wide; that T_1 frame's fin and body turns are undone in the keys), locator1 the body (lean, squash), root the whole sprite's offset (0.5 model units a sprite pixel).
